summary: Frontend performance + regression testing after image/font optimization. All target flows pass. Page load is fast (~0.39s DOMContentLoaded/load), 12 resource requests totaling ~563KB, zero failed network requests (no 404s), hero + all showcase images served locally from /shots/*.webp. Gallery auto-advance + tab switch, sticky bar + countdown decrement, and buy modal -> success -> download flow all work. Mobile 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow and showcase image visible. One minor React DOM prop warning found.

verifications.buy_flow: modal opens -> email accepted -> buy-success shown -> download button visible

console_warnings: Invalid DOM property `fetchpriority`. Did you mean `fetchPriority`? — React expects camelCase JSX attribute. Non-blocking but should be renamed to fetchPriority in Hero.js/Showcase.js JSX.
action_items: Minor: rename JSX attribute `fetchpriority` -> `fetchPriority` in Hero.js (and any other component using it) to remove React DOM prop warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent perf win: hosting compressed WebP locally + preconnect for fonts reduces total payload and eliminates external CDN dependency; total ~563KB and load <400ms is well within target.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing landing page, no backend. All data-testids present and functional: hero-image, showcase-image, showcase-tab-{n}, showcase-caption, sticky-buy-bar, countdown, hero-cta-buy, buy-modal, buy-email-input, buy-submit, buy-success, buy-download-button. Local WebP images in /app/frontend/public/shots/.
